verdict: Teh ais limau is lighter, about ~100 kcal vs sirap bandung ~180 kcal. If you drink it almost every day, the difference really adds up over a week.
why: Teh ais limau is about ~100 kcal, sirap bandung ~180 kcal. You save around 80 kcal per glass.
Sirap bandung has milk, which is why it has 3 g protein and 3 g fat. But 3 g protein isn't enough to keep you full.
Teh ais limau has 0 g fat. Most of its calories come from sugar.
If you drink sirap bandung 5 times a week, that's about 400 kcal more than teh ais limau.
when_a: Sirap bandung suits a wedding, buka puasa or when you're really craving it. One glass, and enjoy it properly.
when_b: Teh ais limau is great as a daily drink at the mamak or warung when you want something cold and a bit sour.
tip: Ask for 'kurang manis' (less sweet) or 'kosong' (no sugar) when ordering. Most shops can do it, and the calories drop a lot.

faq.q: Sirap bandung has milk, so is it more nutritious?
faq.a: There's a little protein and calcium, but the sugar and sweetened condensed milk dominate. For protein, it's better to get it from dishes like egg, fish or chicken.

faq.q: Does teh ais limau kosong taste weird?
faq.a: Many people find it okay because the lime already gives a fresh taste. If it's hard, start with 'kurang manis' (less sweet) first, and your taste buds will get used to it.
